sentences.text: This Criminal Revision Application is taken up for settlement in Lok Adalat, today.
Learned APP Shri JK Shah appearing on behalf of the respondent-State has produced Withdrawal/Settlement purshis, which is taken on record.

Today, Mr. B. R. Brahmbhatt, Food Safety Officer (I Card No. 19730) from the Surat Municipal Corporation, Surat is present before the Court, on behalf of the original complainant Shri (Late) Mahendrabhai Chamanlal Bhatt, Food Inspector, Surat Municipal Corporation.

Designated Officer, Surat Municipal Corporation has also issued a letter of authority in his favour to remain present stating that as the matter is placed in the Lok Adalat before this Court and if the applicant is ready and R/CR.RA/127/2011 ORDER willing to deposit the amount of fine, let the matter be disposed of.
The letter of authority is taken on record.
In view of the withdrawal / settlement pursis moved by the parties under the signature as well as learned advocate appearing on behalf of the parties.

sentences.text: As such, on going through the record, it is noticed that the offence alleged against the original accused-revisionist under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 is not serious in nature and the punishment or penalty for such offence is not substantial, and in view of the provisions of Sections 51 and 52 of the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006, it is compoundable under Section 69 of the said Act.

It is pointed out that by virtue of an Order dated 21st March 2011 passed by this Court, pending hearing and final disposal of the present Criminal Revision Application, the execution,
implementation and operation of the impugned judgment and order of conviction and sentence dated 24th September 2001 passed by the learned J.M.F.C. Municipal Court, Surat in P.F.A. Case No. 22 of 1997, which was confirmed by the learned 3rd Additional Sessions judge, Surat in Criminal Appeal No. 60 of 2001 dated 28th February 2011 has been suspended and the applicant/revisionist is ordered to be released on bail.
In view of purshis of the parties, the present Criminal Revision Application stands disposed of.

The applicant/revisionist is hereby directed to pay fine of Rs. 25,000/= [Rupees Twenty Five thousand only] before the High R/CR.RA/127/2011 ORDER Court Legal Services Committee, High Court of Gujarat Complex, Ahmedabad within a period of four weeks of this Order; as agreed, failing which the Criminal Revision Application shall stand revived automatically.

entities.text: High R/CR.RA/127/2011 ORDER Court Legal Services Committee, High Court of Gujarat Complex, Ahmedabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Accordingly, this Criminal Revision Application stands disposed of as settled on payment of fine; as aforestated.

The judgment and order of conviction and sentence dated 24th September 2001 passed by the learned J.M.F.C. Municipal Court, Surat in P.F.A. Case No. 22 of 1997, which was confirmed by the learned 3rd Additional Sessions judge, Surat in Criminal Appeal No. 60 of 2001 dated 28th February 2011 stands modified by converting the same into fine of Rs. 25,000/= [Rupees Twenty Five thousand only].
R&P; if any, be transmitted back to the trial Court.

It is required to be mentioned here that disposal of this matter will not in any way affect any connected cases arising out of the same, incident or any other proceedings, filed or to be filed before any other Court.
It is also required to be noted that this Order will not be treated as precedent in any future cases for reference.
